The 2025–26 Scottish League One (known as William Hill League One for sponsorship reasons) was the 13th season of Scottish League One, the third tier of Scottish football. The season began on 2 August 2025.[1]

Ten teams contested the league: Alloa Athletic, Cove Rangers, East Fife, Hamilton Academical, Inverness Caledonian Thistle, Kelty Hearts, Montrose, Peterhead, Queen of the South and Stenhousemuir.

[edit]

The following teams changed division after the 2024–25 season.

  • Hamilton Academical

From League One

[edit]

Relegated to League Two

  • Annan Athletic
  • Dumbarton

Promoted to the Championship

  • Arbroath

Results

[edit]

Teams play each other four times, twice in the first half of the season (home and away) and twice in the second half of the season (home and away), making a total of 180 games, with each team playing 36.
